mapper.select: SELECT A.HIS_SEQ AS hisSeq, A.DID_ID AS didId, A.SCH_CODE AS schCode, B.SCH_STARTDAY AS schStartDay, B.SCH_ENDDAY AS schEndDay, B.SCH_NAME AS schName, B.CONTENT_CODE AS contentCode, B.SCH_EMERGUBUN AS schEmerGubun FROM TB_CONTENTSENDHISTORY A JOIN TB_SCHEDULE B ON A.SCH_CODE = B.SCH_CODE JOIN TB_DIDINFO C ON A.DID_ID = C.DID_ID WHERE TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.SCH_STARTDAY AND B.SCH_ENDDAY AND A.DID_UPDATECHECK = 'N' AND B.SCH_USEYN = 'Y' AND C.DID_ID = #{didId} AND C.DID_MACADDRESS = #{didMacAddress}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CONTENTSENDHISTORY ( HIS_SEQ, DID_ID, SCH_CODE, DID_UPDATECHECK, CON_UPDATECHECK, CON_PAGEUPDATECHECK, CON_FILEUPDATECHECK ) VALUES ( NEXTVAL('conSeqHis'), #{didId}, #{schCode}, 'N', 'N', 'N', 'N' )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CONTENTSENDHISTORY SET DID_UPDATECHECK = 'Y' WHERE HIS_SEQ = #{hisSeq}::numeric
UPDATE TB_CONTENTSENDHISTORY SET CON_UPDATECHECK = 'Y' WHERE HIS_SEQ = #{hisSeq}::numeric
UPDATE TB_CONTENTSENDHISTORY SET CON_PAGEUPDATECHECK = 'Y' WHERE HIS_SEQ = #{hisSeq}::numeric
UPDATE TB_CONTENTSENDHISTORY SET CON_FILEUPDATECHECK = 'Y' WHERE HIS_SEQ = #{hisSeq}::numeric
UPDATE TB_CONTENTSENDHISTORY SET CON_UPDATECHECK = 'N', DID_UPDATECHECK = 'N', CON_FILEUPDATECHECK = 'N' WHERE HIS_SEQ = #{hisSeq}::numeric
